name: signal-audit-workbench-frontend
frontend_contract: Current candidate contract, compensation and Q1/Q2 first. Desktop policies may sit side by side; each policy reads Q1 then Q2 vertically. Candidate research uses responsibility, time changes, market pressure, external context and compensation. Audit and exact raw originals remain in native disclosures. Shared market background and global operations follow the policies. Same-origin current API, polling, financial values and permissions are unchanged.
numeric_source_contract: Macro component_summaries preserve producer symbols, raw close levels, reference/observation times and units. FRED DTWEXBGS is the connected broad-dollar series; legacy DXY remains a separate unconnected product label when present. Dollar and volatility index moves show index/relative units, while US10Y changes show yield-change bp without relabeling raw index scale as yield percent. The actual volatility source may be VOLQ, VXN or VIX. Micro momentum_return_pct and actual coverage are separate from TMVF trend strength. Funding raw fractions are formatted as percent and bp; window sums, counts and times are source values, never option net credit. No new market measurements are inferred from scores.
reading_guidance_contract: Each candidate may carry server reading_guidance.status and notes[].text_cn. Notes explain adverse Put/Call responsibility, existing compensation inputs and source-qualified EDB conflicts. Missing risk references prevent EV ranking; synthetic/background identities remain explicit. No new probability, statistical estimate, automatic side choice or execution permission is created.
market_context_contract: Top-level market_context is the FMZ fact_context. The frontend displays status, source time, BTC current price and gaps, then non-LLM volume_price, macro_pressure, price-path/funding and edb_reasoning cards. Each card separates source facts, interpretation/counter-evidence and policy impact without turning scores into side-selection votes. The space_context card is grouped with SpaceGate in one section. It reads nested GEX walls and USD-denominated net Gamma from the producer snapshot, never labels the separate gate NetGamma or Greeks-times-OI proxy as USD GEX net Gamma. Skew and NR remain compact context. Missing layers and score-only fields stay explicit gaps; same-source facts are not independent votes and Put/Call stay parallel.
btc_map_contract: The frontend reads btc_map@1 only from the workbench payload: view.btc_map for global MAP, and candidates[i].btc_map or candidate.snapshot.data_identity.btc_map for a policy MAP. map.presentation is preferred when present for decision_brief, axis, background and source wording, while current map.background metrics, reference_pool, contract references and policy_link remain valid data sources. The MAP section follows the candidate and two-question priority reading area and renders a four-question brief, four background rows, at most six default market references, response events, and selected Put/Call policy liability rows without recomputing amounts. The policy selector and SVG region selection are local-only and do not fetch, post, choose a side, trigger LLM, change mu_ref/M_ref, or imply trade permission. Missing, stale, historical replay, simulated fixture, current, nominal-only and display-only identities stay visible; raw record ids and long hashes stay out of the main visual hierarchy.
map_decision_brief_contract: presentation.decision_brief owns the four-question MAP summary: pushes, conflicts, policy_position and watch. If it is absent, the frontend states that the summary has not been generated and does not promote old fact_summary sentences. Watch.primary_region_id may select an existing local region id only; no API request or side choice is made. Background source_explanation is rendered visibly for allocation, inventory, financing and external conditions. ETF BTC-equivalent amounts are source-price conversions, not actual ETF BTC purchases. CP is rendered as short/long/all-chain capitalized price. Binance BTCUSDT U-margined perpetual OI and settled funding are background facts; funding is not option fee and OI is not direction.
map_presentation_v241_contract: The price axis uses pixel_x = left + (price - domain_min) / (domain_max - domain_min) * width and exposes a pure buildMapAxisModel hook for local validation. Focus mode always includes current price and the active contract legs/qualified BE, then nearby comparable references; far nominal or heterogeneous references are listed below the chart without x-axis coordinates and do not squeeze the active contract. Existing opposite-side candidates can appear on the axis only when they share the same MAP cutoff; otherwise they move to an off-axis note with their freeze time and remain switchable. Selected-region responsibility reads policy_link.region_liability_full_rows and response facts only; the browser never recalculates terminal payout, static net result, BE, mu_ref or M_ref.
space_gate_contract: One combined section places space_context position evidence beside SpaceGate validity checks and blocking reasons, with a compact paired fact layout. Top-level SpaceGate displays current data time, Chinese FMZ-native provenance, Anchor score/state/source/freshness, NetGamma value/sign/source/freshness/transition/conflict, state start time and translated blocking reasons. Missing or invalid FMZ-native gate is shown as STRUCTURE_BLOCKED without hiding independent spatial fact gaps. A simulated_space_gate with preview.kind=synthetic_fixture is always rendered as local synthetic preview, not a real current FMZ fact.
candidate_contract: Put and Call remain side by side. The main brief shows the two legs, quantity, expiry, c/f/mu_ref/M_ref, same-version review and direct review/MAP controls. Full leg premiums, fee split, net entry credit, spot/USD equivalents, breakeven roots, Delta/capture time, gaps, source qualification and liability tables remain in native disclosure. Entry fee is never filled from unknown total holding fee. All figures come from the same server snapshot; quotes are sequential-leg estimates, not fills. Net credit means short premium minus protection cost minus two-leg theoretical transaction fee. Full holding fees remain separate for M_ref.
manual_review_contract: Manual review and purpose=observation share one authenticated endpoint, cooldown, inflight lock, idempotency and shared HTTP budget. Observation explains a frozen policy with local gaps retained and never permits production attachment or execution. Passive page refresh never calls LLM.
preview_contract: If /api/workbench returns preview.kind=synthetic_fixture on a loopback host, the page shows a prominent local synthetic preview banner, may POST a demo review without Authorization Bearer, and labels the receipt as simulated with zero real LLM calls and no trading meaning. Non-loopback preview cannot use the tokenless demo path.
history_contract: Historical cards can be searched and opened as raw JSON, including old LLM and integrity hash fields. Raw ids, hashes and schema fields are kept out of the main visual hierarchy and remain available inside the raw JSON viewer. Historical cards are read-only evidence and do not become current workbench data.
daily_snapshot_contract: The page displays the latest 15 daily 23:00 snapshots supplied by the backend; refresh, state mail, daily snapshots and old NR events do not call LLM.
data_engine_contract: Registered adapters are not live proof. The workbench GET reads cache only and rechecks use eligibility; background and explicit manual capture own collection. Data health separates collection, quality and usage. Actual day/manual freezes retain source values and stable manifests. No automatic LLM or economic upgrade.
research_closure: R17 unchanged: risk tool useful, business unproven, actual EV unknown; this frontend update does not change model, trading permission, deployment, natural-card consumption or economic validity.
audit_layout_contract: Each candidate has point evidence, one research entry and one audit/replay entry. The first evidence depth shows frozen facts and scope; exact model text, refs, hashes and raw inputs remain accessible. Global receipt summaries link back to the candidate. Expanded or reachable evidence does not prove user reading.
local_review_contract: Candidate Q1/Q2 is the unique primary explanation. Strict same-input accepted research receipts are readable without production attachment. Missing or rejected current review uses program facts; historical accepted receipts stay folded. Point evidence and source clocks remain auditable.
round1_repair_contract: Current candidates and Q1/Q2 precede source details, using direct anchors and native details disclosure. bounded_claim_ids@2.4.5 retains nine wire fields; the program derives Q1/Q2 from the frozen catalog and deterministic account. Nonpositive M requires its counter and repricing condition, missing mu stays an explicit gap, closed SpaceGate stays closed. Preview uses six finite scenarios, real calculation/validation and a simulated ID selector only; receipt binding requires candidate, snapshot and MAP identity, remains SIMULATED and never grants production attachment or execution.
round2_repair_contract: One program-derived frozen decision_relations connects horizon, geometry, qualified directional facts and unknown per-risk mu attribution; bounded wire retains nine fields. Q2 separates risk coverage from formula liability and states deterministic repricing with frozen fees/mu. Same-version native disclosures survive render; changed snapshot resets. Stale receipts remain folded history. Preview ETF means reconcile with totals; W4 directional evidence reconciles; W5 differs from W2 only in Gamma and required gates.
round3_repair_contract: Candidate-local Q1/Q2 derive a concise attention disposition, at most two existing observable changes and waiting tradeoffs from the same frozen facts. Unknown per-risk coverage is an evidence boundary, not a new hard gate. No side ranking, new score, risk model or execution state. MAP audit disclosures retain current DOM open state only under exact candidate/snapshot/MAP identity, resetting on version changes. Narrow-screen region labels and prices stack; duplicated preview identity is consolidated while full boundaries remain available.
round4_repair_contract: All-mode axis domain includes every contract bound allowed on the axis, including same-cutoff peer legs and breakeven points; equal price distances preserve equal coordinate distances for either selected side. Focus-mode off-axis disclosure and nominal/different-cutoff separation remain unchanged. Frontend v2.4.8 retains bounded_claim_ids@2.4.7 and unchanged producer/financial contracts. Local release preparation does not imply a complete Git release, server installation or real-provider verification.
round5_repair_contract: Candidate receipt navigation reuses the MAP side selection and server-attached same-snapshot review; global last_result remains separate. Preview reuses existing idempotency receipts and frozen snapshot expiry, without a second history store or live countdown. Overall applicability is labeled as a combined review status; compensation counter-evidence belongs to Q2. No normalized receipt, bounded_claim_ids@2.4.7 protocol, accounting or permission changes. Local v2.4.9 is not the round4 release package and is not published.
wpem_frontend_contract: Read-only consumption binding is separate from trading quote TTL, review cooldown and execution permission. Research-only accepted Q1/Q2 may explain the exact displayed frozen input, never a newer snapshot. WPEM strict Delta/Path and observed adjacent fragments keep separate scopes.
information_polish_contract: Presentation-only derivative of frozen WPEM Consumer RC. Useful numbers, contracts, Q1/Q2, responsibility, uncertainty, window qualification, raw sources and audit remain reachable. Price axis appears before detailed backgrounds, with complete contract price readouts. Operational and raw protocol details fold without changing review action or financial semantics. WPEM Delta reads existing delta.changes, never recalculates; an old receipt STALE does not hide existing candidate facts. No new LLM calls or runtime changes.
decision_workspace_contract: Presentation-only: existing policy checkpoints, WPEM path/coverage/dependency/cross-section and source-qualified guidance have readable research disclosures. Program questions reuse existing attribution; c-minus-f remains the hold-to-expiry account. Full source/protocol audit remains reachable; geometry, qualification, financial calculations, LLM inputs/outputs and permissions are unchanged.
evidence_routing_contract: Existing evidence_routing@1.0.0 and wpem_review_evidence@1.1.0 supply the actual frozen input. The model adds Q1/Q2 explanations with supplied evidence references; the program retains contract numbers, source clocks, partial gaps and permissions. Older receipts replay under their own protocols. No new model or admission state.
observation_lineage_contract: Read-only selector binding and source pointers; actual accepted point array indices; produced/included/referenced/rendered distinctions; explicit public consumption capture. Original consumption time is not reconstructed. Frozen offline replay uses existing validators and preserves semantic rejection, null risk references and permissions.
ui_information_architecture_contract: Presentation only. Finite terminology mappings preserve accepted point order, qualifiers, original text, refs and public capture semantics. Strict window evidence and local fragments retain distinct scopes. Unknown source clocks remain unknown. Current, historical and rejected bindings are unchanged. Same-identity reading state and ancestor-opening navigation do not fetch facts or call models. UI closure has zero LLM HTTP calls.

locked_followup_contract: Explicit authenticated lock freezes the exact displayed snapshot and packet, without LLM. Immutable t0 survives default-candidate rotation and restart; the existing collector observes the original contract within bounded budgets. Same-app follow-up separates endpoints, latest WPEM window, observed samples and gaps; fixed original BE and public close-book estimates are not account fills or actual PnL. Reads and offline HTML exports do not collect or invoke models.
observation_rc_contract: Display projections do not alter source evidence or financial qualification. Exact evidence is fetched only on demand. Bounded private sessions replace repeated browser Bearer entry; reads and exports never grant execution permission.
